Overview of Both Tools

DaySmart Vet

DaySmart Vet is a cloud-based veterinary practice management platform founded in 2011 and headquartered in Ann Arbor, MI. Marketed as "easy-to-use cloud-based practice management", it serves thousands of practices and is best suited for small to mid-size practices, client communication focus, practices wanting simplicity. The platform supports Small animal, General practice practice types.

Hippo Manager

Hippo Manager is a cloud-based veterinary software solution founded in 2013 and headquartered in USA. Described as "simple, intuitive cloud veterinary software", it serves growing user base and is best suited for small practices wanting simplicity, budget-conscious clinics, solo vets. It supports Small animal, General practice practice types.

Feature-by-Feature Comparison

We evaluated DaySmart Vet and Hippo Manager across six key areas that matter most to veterinary practices.

Clinical Features / EMR

Tie

Both platforms offer medical records and basic clinical tools, but neither is as feature-rich as premium options like ezyVet or Digitail. DaySmart Vet includes medical notes and automated waitlists. Hippo Manager provides patient records, scheduling, and invoicing. For basic clinical needs, they are comparable.

Scheduling & Booking

DaySmart Vet wins

DaySmart Vet offers online booking and automated waitlists, which help fill cancellations efficiently. Hippo Manager includes scheduling and reminders but lacks the automated waitlist feature. If managing no-shows and cancellations is a priority, DaySmart Vet has the edge.

Client Communication

DaySmart Vet wins

DaySmart Vet is particularly strong here with two-way text messaging, which allows real-time conversations with pet owners. Hippo Manager offers a client portal and reminders but does not emphasize two-way texting. For practices that want to communicate with clients the way people prefer today (via text), DaySmart Vet is the clear winner.

Pricing & Value

Tie

Both start at $120/mo, making them equally accessible. DaySmart Vet uses per-practice pricing, and Hippo Manager does as well. Both offer free trials, and neither has a free plan. The value proposition comes down to which features matter more to your practice.

Integrations

Tie

Hippo Manager integrates with IDEXX, Antech, and Zoetis for lab work. DaySmart Vet integrates with ALLYDVM, QuickBooks, and various payment processors. Hippo Manager has the stronger lab integration story, while DaySmart Vet offers better accounting connectivity.

Ease of Use

Hippo Manager wins

Both platforms are designed for simplicity. Hippo Manager is frequently praised for its clean, uncluttered interface and good customer support. DaySmart Vet offers good onboarding support and a user-friendly interface. Both are suitable for non-technical staff, but Hippo Manager's simplicity gives it a slight edge for the least tech-savvy teams.

Our Recommendation

If client communication is your top priority, especially two-way texting and automated waitlists, DaySmart Vet is the better fit. If you want the simplest, cleanest interface with solid customer support and a focus on core practice management, Hippo Manager is an excellent choice. Both are priced identically at $120/mo and offer free trials, so we recommend trying both before committing.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is DaySmart Vet or Hippo Manager cheaper?

Both start at $120/mo with per-practice pricing, making them equally accessible. The total cost will depend on any add-on features or modules you choose. Both offer free trials so you can evaluate before purchasing.

Which is better for small practices?

Both are well-suited for small practices. Hippo Manager is slightly simpler and often praised for its clean interface, making it ideal for the least tech-savvy teams. DaySmart Vet offers stronger client communication tools that more tech-comfortable practices will appreciate.

Do both offer free trials?

Yes, both DaySmart Vet and Hippo Manager offer free trials. Since they are priced identically, we strongly recommend testing both to see which interface your team prefers.

Which has better client communication features?

DaySmart Vet has the edge here with two-way text messaging, automated waitlists, and online booking. Hippo Manager offers a client portal and reminders but does not match DaySmart Vet's real-time texting capabilities.
